The following [[Outline (list)|outline]] is provided as an overview of and topical guide to crafts:

<!-- Lead paragraph: -->
{{Transclude lead excerpt| Craft | paragraphs=1 |  more=no }}

A craft is a work of physical expression drawn from imagination or existing culture, largely by using hands. A craft is typically birthed by creativity and intentional design, through the application of skill(s)/ techniques and can extend across a wide range of areas from dance, embroidery to photography. Good 'craftsmanship' is marked by dexterity and experience.<ref>{{Cite web | title=craft Meaning in the Cambridge English Dictionary | url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/craft | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150901003728/http://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/craft | access-date=2025-05-04 | archive-date=1 September 2015 | url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/craft | title=CRAFT definition and meaning {{pipe}} Collins English Dictionary }}</ref>

{{TOC limit|limit=2}}

== What type of thing are crafts? ==

Crafts as a whole can be described as all of the following:

* One of [[the arts]] – as an art form, crafts are an outlet of human expression, usually influenced by culture and which in turn help to change culture. Crafts are a physical manifestation of the internal human creative impulse and typically involves the use of hands to create the artform.
** One of the visual arts – visual arts is a class of art forms, including painting, sculpture, photography, printmaking and others, that focus on the creation of works which are primarily visual in nature.
